messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm doing a quickstart / onboarding refresh (hello-world app, auth setup, first deployment). Goal: reduce friction for new devs, add a tiny Docker local dev flow, and fix the broken auth link. I'll open a draft PR later today. cc @kevin @samir

kevin: Nice. Can you include both JS and Python SDK snippets (copy/paste runnable)? Also add a tiny curl token example for debugging.

samir: Yup — prefer to standardize on the new client API (client.auth.login) in examples. I'll provide a v2 snippet.

maria: Question: for the browser auth flow should the tutorial use PKCE by default? I'm leaning that way to avoid security footguns.

lisa: Agree on PKCE. Add a short paragraph about redirect URIs + example env vars. Maybe a note about local dev (http://localhost:5173).

kevin: Also add a troubleshooting section for common 401s and CORS. One-liners are fine.

samir: Paste JS snippet I suggest (feel free to format):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
// PKCE flow helper
await client.auth.login({ flow: 'pkce', redirectUri: 'http://localhost:5173/auth/callback' });
```

maria: Perfect. I'll include the JS + equivalent Python example and a tiny Docker Compose for local emulation of the frontend.

maria: I'll open the PR as a draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/234 — branch: docs/quickstart-refresh. Please add review comments inline.

docs-bot: Preview build queued for PR #234 (branch: docs/quickstart-refresh). Status: queued.

deploy-bot: Preview deployed: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/quickstart-refresh-234 (expires in 7 days).

kevin: Quick nit on the preview: sample import should be `@redwood/inference-js` not `@redwood/inference`. Also update package version to v0.9 in examples.

samir: I'll push a small commit to the PR branch to replace the snippet and add the PKCE helper function.

maria: Thanks — could someone double-check the auth link in the existing sidebar? There's a 404 from old `getting-started/auth.html`. I'll add a redirect in the PR if that's confirmed.

lisa: Confirmed the old link 404s. We should add a redirect + a short migration note for Dedicated customers: API key scopes and server-side token rotation.

kevin: For Dedicated customers add an ops note: "Set REDWOOD_HOST to your private control plane, and ensure KMS is configured for keys."

maria: Will add both notes and ping again when PR is ready for full review. ETA EOD. :thumbsup:

samir: Happy to review the SDK code + run the examples locally this afternoon.

kevin: FYI I'll add a tiny CI check to the docs PR that runs the demo app build to catch missing env vars.

maria: Great — thanks everyone. We'll aim to ship this week.
